action.objective: Commit verified a8a6+ (Qa6+), the top exact depth-4 move, forcing Black to block or lose material.
action.rationale: a8a6+ has full depth-4 verification scoring 2290, safety complete with no mating reply and tactical_refutation not_found. It gives check, driving the Black king, and the PV shows Black must block (e5e6) then White captures the rook on e6, winning material while keeping the queen active. It strictly dominates the alternatives: a8c6 was an upper-bound depth-2 estimate, e4e5 scored lower at depth 2. a8a6 is the only commit_ready move and no risk acceptance is needed.
